about.title: Small team. Thoughtful work.
about.intro: emvalue is a two-person web studio in Australia. We design and build websites, apps and business tools for small businesses, in English and Chinese, and run Xiaohongshu creator campaigns in Melbourne.

sections.title: Work directly with the people building it.
body: We work as a small team, from understanding your business to designing and building the result. You can discuss the details directly with us, in English or Chinese.

Meetings, feedback and project updates are arranged around an agreed schedule. We work online with businesses across Australia and overseas. If you'd prefer to meet in person, we can arrange it in Sydney, Melbourne or Perth.

sections.title: Start with what your customers need.
body: A restaurant might need a readable menu and an easy booking path. A tradesperson might need a clear service area and a straightforward quote request. A growing business might need an app or an internal tool.
We help define the smallest useful starting point, then choose the design and technology that fit your needs, budget and ability to maintain it.

sections.title: Clear scope before work begins.
body: We discuss your goals, current website, content and timing, then provide a written proposal. It sets out deliverables, revisions, fees, payment milestones and responsibilities.
Domain and service accounts should be in your name. Handover materials, licences and any ongoing support are agreed in writing, so you know what you are receiving and what comes next.

sections.title: Explore our design concepts.
body: The interactive websites in our collection are original concepts for fictional businesses. They show design directions and interactions; they are not claims of completed client projects or customer results.
Use them to explain the feel you like. Your project is then shaped around your actual business, content and customers.

about.contact_title: Tell us what you have in mind.
about.contact_body: Share your business, current website and the problem you would like to solve. We can work out a sensible next step together.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: How emvalue handles website enquiries, project information and the preferences saved in your browser.

sections.title: 1. Who this notice is for
body: This notice applies to the two-person studio working under the emvalue brand. For privacy enquiries, contact emvalue.studio@gmail.com. The actual service provider for paid work is identified in the written project agreement.

sections.title: 2. Information we receive
body: When you contact us, we receive the information you send: your name, reply email, business details, location, project needs, preferred timing, selected design references, message and any optional alternative contact details. The website enquiry form requires a name and reply email; other fields are optional.

During a project, we may also receive agreed project materials, approvals and billing details. Please do not put passwords, payment card details, identity documents or sensitive personal information in an enquiry. We can agree a suitable method if a project needs restricted access or other sensitive material.

sections.title: 3. Why we use it
body: We use this information to respond to enquiries, understand scope, prepare quotes, communicate about and deliver agreed work, maintain business records and handle requests or disputes. We do not sell enquiry information or automatically add enquirers to marketing lists.

You may choose not to provide optional details. Without a working reply address, we may be unable to respond; without enough project information, we may need to ask follow-up questions before quoting.

sections.title: 4. Forms, email and service providers
body: When online submission is enabled, Netlify Forms processes and stores the submitted enquiry and applies spam filtering. Notification emails and direct correspondence are handled through our Gmail inbox. Providers may also process technical data such as IP addresses, request logs and spam signals to deliver and protect their services.

Our hosting provider processes the technical requests needed to serve the website. Google Fonts supplies the typefaces through external requests from your browser. Providers may process data outside Australia, including in the United States; locations depend on their service arrangements. Their own privacy terms also apply to their processing.

Access to enquiries is limited to the team members and providers needed for the relevant task. Other project tools or disclosures will be discussed where relevant. We may also disclose information where required by law or reasonably necessary to handle a legal claim.

sections.title: 5. Browser storage and cookies
body: This site uses local storage to remember your try-on business name, saved designs and viewing preferences on your device. Typing in the form does not send its contents to us. Saved design references are included if you submit an enquiry or send the prepared email.

We have not added advertising trackers or an analytics service to this site. Local storage is separate from cookies. You can remove these saved preferences through your browser’s site-data settings; clearing them also clears your saved designs. External links and services have their own storage practices.

sections.title: 6. Retention and protection
body: We keep information for as long as reasonably needed for the purposes described here, including agreed work, business records and legal obligations. We review information we no longer need and delete or de-identify it where appropriate. Provider backup and deletion cycles may affect when all copies are removed.

We use reasonable access controls and account security measures appropriate to a small studio. No internet service can promise absolute security. If you believe information has been sent to the wrong place or exposed, contact us promptly.

sections.title: 7. Access, correction and concerns
body: Email emvalue.studio@gmail.com to ask about your information, request access, correction or deletion, or raise a privacy concern. We may need to verify your identity. We will respond within a reasonable time and explain if we cannot fulfil a request, including where records must be retained.

If a concern remains unresolved, you may seek guidance from the privacy regulator applicable to your circumstances, including Australia’s Office of the Australian Information Commissioner where it has jurisdiction. This notice does not limit any rights that apply to you under law.

sections.title: 8. Changes to this policy
body: We update this notice when our services or information practices change. The date above identifies the current version. We will provide additional notice where a material change or applicable law requires it.

privacy.contact_body: For project questions, these terms or requests about your personal information, email:
privacy.form_live: Online enquiries are processed through Netlify Forms. You can also contact us directly by email.
privacy.form_pending: Online submission is currently unavailable. Enquiries reach us only if you send an email; filling in this form does not send your details.

terms.title: Website terms
terms.intro: The terms for browsing emvalue, exploring our design concepts and sending an enquiry.

sections.title: 1. Using this website
body: This website is published by the team working under the emvalue brand. Use it lawfully and do not attempt to disrupt the service, access information without permission, or submit malicious or misleading material.

sections.title: 2. Design concepts and website information
body: The businesses, offers and transactions shown inside our interactive design concepts are fictional demonstrations. They are not real businesses, client endorsements or working booking and payment services.

We aim to keep our service information accurate, but content and availability may change. Design examples do not promise a particular business outcome, search ranking, revenue or delivery timeframe. We will confirm the scope and suitability of your project in writing.

sections.title: 3. Content and intellectual property
body: Unless stated otherwise, website designs, text, code and brand materials are owned by emvalue’s creators or used under the relevant licences. You may browse the site and share links. Copying or commercially reusing substantial parts requires permission or an applicable licence or legal exception.
Exploring a concept or submitting an enquiry does not transfer intellectual property rights. Rights in commissioned work are set out in the written project agreement.

sections.title: 4. Enquiries and project agreements
body: Submitting an enquiry does not place an order, create a paid project or oblige you to proceed. We first clarify your requirements and provide a written proposal. Work begins only after scope, fees and the actual contracting parties are agreed.

The project cooperation terms explain our usual approach. They apply to a project only to the extent included in or accepted as part of its written agreement. Specific agreed project terms take priority where they differ, subject to applicable law.

sections.title: 5. External services and availability
body: Links may take you to services operated by others, including social platforms, email and third-party tools. Their terms and privacy practices apply to your use of them. We cannot control their content or uninterrupted availability.
We take reasonable care in operating this site, but maintenance, outages or errors may occur. Contact us if you find something broken or inaccurate.

sections.title: 6. Your legal rights and changes
body: Nothing in these terms excludes, restricts or modifies rights, guarantees or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded, including applicable rights under the Australian Consumer Law.

We may update these website terms prospectively by publishing a dated version. An update does not change an existing project agreement without the parties’ agreement or override your legal rights. For questions or complaints, email emvalue.studio@gmail.com.

terms.contact_body: For project questions, these terms or requests about your personal information, email:

project-terms.title: Project cooperation terms
project-terms.intro: A clear starting point for working together. Your written proposal confirms the deliverables, responsibilities, fees and terms for your particular project.

sections.title: 1. Confirm the agreement
body: Before paid work begins, we identify the actual service provider and client in the written agreement, including applicable business registration details. emvalue is the studio brand used to introduce our services.

These general terms apply only when incorporated into or accepted as part of your project agreement. A proposal should state how and when it is accepted. Sending an enquiry alone does not commit either party to a project.

sections.title: 2. Scope, content and revisions
body: The proposal defines pages, features, platforms, languages, deliverables, revision rounds and exclusions. You provide agreed business information, materials, access and approvals, and confirm you have the rights needed for materials supplied.
We agree who is responsible for copywriting, photography, translations, business claims and legal content. A change to agreed scope is priced and scheduled for approval before the extra work begins.

sections.title: 3. Timing and approvals
body: We agree milestones based on scope, availability and when content, access and feedback can be provided. Delays or dependencies are discussed promptly and the schedule is updated by agreement.

You receive a preview or other agreed review opportunity. We document feedback and agree how completion and acceptance will be confirmed; silence is not automatically treated as acceptance under these general terms.

sections.title: 4. Quotes and payment
body: The written quote states the currency, fees, payment milestones, quote validity and whether GST applies. GST is charged only where lawfully applicable. Any deposit and its purpose are stated before payment is requested.

Domain registration, hosting, paid software, app-store accounts and other third-party subscriptions are listed separately where needed. We obtain approval for additional charges. Ongoing renewals and who pays them are explained before you commit.

sections.title: 5. Ownership, licences and handover
body: Your existing content and materials remain yours. The agreement specifies the rights granted or transferred in paid custom deliverables, the files and access supplied, and any agreed payment conditions for handover.

Third-party fonts, stock assets, open-source code, platforms and pre-existing tools remain subject to their own licences. We clarify relevant restrictions. Domain and service accounts should be registered in your name wherever practical, with access granted for the work.

sections.title: 6. Launch, fixes and ongoing support
body: The project agreement defines testing, launch responsibilities and the process for reporting and fixing work that does not meet the agreed specification, alongside any rights required by law.

Hosting administration, content changes, backups, security updates and response arrangements are included only where expressly agreed. Additional maintenance can be arranged separately. Third-party approvals, platform rules and service outages may affect launch or operation.

sections.title: 7. Pausing or ending a project
body: If either party needs to pause or end a project, we discuss notice, work completed, deliverables and reasonable next steps. Any breach and opportunity to remedy it are handled according to the agreement and applicable law.

A fair settlement takes account of agreed work performed and approved, committed third-party costs. Unused prepaid amounts and refunds are considered accordingly, subject to applicable consumer rights. These general terms do not make every deposit automatically non-refundable or require payment for all unfinished work.

sections.title: 8. Confidentiality and project materials
body: Each party should use the other’s non-public project information only for the agreed work or as required by law, and limit access to those who need it. Additional confidentiality or data-processing arrangements can be agreed for projects that need them.
We ask permission before using your business name, project screenshots or testimonial in our portfolio or marketing, unless you have already expressly agreed that use.

sections.title: 9. Resolving concerns and legal rights
body: Raise concerns at emvalue.studio@gmail.com so we can discuss and try to resolve them in good faith. This does not prevent either party from seeking advice, contacting a regulator or using available legal remedies.

Nothing here excludes, restricts or modifies non-excludable rights, consumer guarantees or remedies, including those under the Australian Consumer Law where applicable. Any project-specific limitation must respect those rights.

about.title: 小团队，认真做好每一件事。
about.intro: emvalue 是一家澳洲的两人网站工作室，为小企业设计和开发网站、App 与业务工具，中英文直接沟通；在墨尔本提供小红书博主推广。

sections.title: 直接和做项目的人沟通。
body: 从了解生意、设计方案到开发交付，我们以小团队的方式参与。你可以直接与我们讨论细节，用中文或英文沟通。
会议、反馈和进度按约定安排。我们以线上合作为主，服务全澳及海外客户；如需当面沟通，可在悉尼、墨尔本、珀斯安排。

sections.title: 先想清楚，你的客人需要什么。
body: 餐馆可能需要清楚的菜单和方便的订位入口；装修师傅可能需要明确的服务区域与报价咨询；成长中的生意可能需要一个 App 或内部工具。
先从真正有用的一步开始，再根据需求、预算和后续维护能力，选择合适的设计与技术。

sections.title: 先把范围说清楚，再动手。
body: 了解目标、现有网站、内容与时间安排后，我们会提供书面方案，说明交付内容、修改轮次、费用、付款节点和双方需要准备的事项。
域名与服务账户应注册在你名下。交付文件、许可与后续支持会提前约定，让你清楚收到什么，以及上线以后如何继续。

sections.title: 通过概念作品，找到你喜欢的方向。
body: 盒子里的互动网站是为虚构商家设计的原创概念作品，用来展示风格与交互，并非真实客户案例，也不代表已实现的商业效果。
你可以把喜欢的作品作为沟通起点。真正的项目会围绕你的生意、内容与客群来设计。

about.contact_body: 告诉我们你的生意、现有网站与想解决的问题。我们一起确定合适的下一步。

privacy.title: 隐私政策
privacy.intro: 我们如何处理网站咨询、项目资料，以及保存在你浏览器中的偏好。

sections.title: 1. 这份政策适用于谁
body: 本政策适用于以 emvalue 品牌提供服务的两人工作室。有关隐私，请联系 emvalue.studio@gmail.com。付费项目的实际服务提供方会在书面项目协议中明确。

sections.title: 2. 我们会收到哪些信息
body: 当你联系我们时，我们会收到你主动提供的称呼、回复邮箱、生意信息、所在地、项目需求、期望时间、选择的设计参考、留言，以及可选的其他联系方式。网站咨询表单必填称呼和回复邮箱，其余字段均为选填。
项目合作期间，我们也可能收到约定的项目素材、确认记录与开票信息。请勿在公开咨询表单中填写密码、银行卡信息、身份证件或敏感个人信息。项目确需受限访问权限或其他敏感资料时，我们会另行约定合适的提供方式。

sections.title: 3. 我们如何使用信息
body: 这些信息用于回复咨询、了解需求、准备报价、沟通和交付约定工作、保留业务记录，以及处理请求或争议。我们不出售咨询信息，也不会因为你发来咨询就自动把你加入营销名单。
你可以不填写选填内容。没有有效的回复邮箱，我们可能无法回复；项目信息不足时，我们可能需要进一步了解后才能报价。

sections.title: 4. 表单、邮箱与服务商
body: 在线提交启用后，Netlify Forms 会接收和保存提交的咨询，并进行垃圾信息过滤；通知邮件及直接往来邮件由我们的 Gmail 邮箱处理。服务商也可能为提供和保护服务而处理 IP 地址、请求日志、反垃圾信号等技术信息。
网站托管商处理加载网站所需的技术请求。网站字体由 Google Fonts 提供，你的浏览器会向其发送外部请求。服务商可能在澳洲以外处理数据，包括美国，具体地点取决于其服务安排；其自身的隐私条款也适用于相关处理。
咨询内容仅供完成相关工作所需的团队成员与服务商访问。项目涉及其他工具或披露安排时，我们会视情况与你沟通。法律要求或合理处理法律争议所需时，我们也可能披露相关信息。

sections.title: 5. 浏览器存储与 Cookie
body: 网站使用本地存储，在你的设备上记住试穿店名、收藏的作品和浏览偏好。填写表单的过程中，内容不会发送给我们。你提交咨询或发送准备好的邮件时，选中的设计参考才会随需求一起提供。
本网站未接入广告追踪器或流量分析服务。本地存储与 Cookie 不同；你可以通过浏览器的网站数据设置清除这些偏好，同时也会清除收藏。外部链接与服务有各自的存储规则。

sections.title: 6. 保存期限与保护
body: 我们在合理需要的期限内保存信息，以完成上述目的，包括约定工作、业务记录与法律义务。对于不再需要的信息，我们会审查并适当删除或去标识化；服务商的备份与删除周期可能影响所有副本完全移除的时间。
我们采取适合小型工作室的合理访问控制与账户安全措施。任何互联网服务都无法保证绝对安全。如果你认为资料误发或泄露，请及时联系我们。

sections.title: 7. 查询、更正与隐私问题
body: 如需了解个人信息的处理、申请访问、更正或删除，或提出隐私问题，请发送邮件至 emvalue.studio@gmail.com。我们可能需要核实身份，并会在合理时间内回复；无法满足请求时，会说明原因，包括需要依法保留记录的情况。
若问题未解决，你可以向适用于你情况的隐私监管机构寻求指引，包括在其管辖范围内的澳洲信息专员办公室（OAIC）。本政策不限制法律赋予你的任何权利。

sections.title: 8. 政策更新
body: 服务或信息处理方式变化时，我们会更新本政策，以上方日期标识当前版本。重大变化或适用法律要求额外告知时，我们会提供相应通知。

privacy.contact_body: 关于项目、这些条款或个人信息的请求，请发送邮件至：
privacy.form_live: 在线咨询由 Netlify Forms 接收处理，你也可以直接通过邮箱联系我们。
privacy.form_pending: 在线提交目前尚未开放。只有你发送邮件后，我们才会收到咨询；填写此表单不会将内容发送给我们。

terms.title: 网站使用条款
terms.intro: 关于浏览 emvalue、体验概念作品与提交咨询的约定。

sections.title: 1. 使用本网站
body: 本网站由以 emvalue 品牌开展工作的团队发布。请合法使用网站，不要干扰服务、未经许可访问信息，或提交恶意及误导性内容。

sections.title: 2. 概念作品与网站信息
body: 互动概念作品中的商家、优惠和交易流程均为虚构展示，并非真实商家、客户背书或可用的预约与支付服务。
我们尽力保持服务信息准确，但内容和可提供的服务可能变化。设计示例不承诺特定商业效果、搜索排名、收入或交付时间。项目的范围与适用性会以书面形式确认。

sections.title: 3. 内容与知识产权
body: 除另有说明外，网站设计、文字、代码与品牌素材属于 emvalue 的创作者，或依据相应许可使用。你可以浏览网站并分享链接。复制或商业使用其中实质性内容，应取得许可，或符合适用授权与法律例外。
体验概念作品或提交咨询不会转移知识产权。委托项目中的权利归属以书面项目协议约定。

sections.title: 4. 咨询与项目协议
body: 提交咨询不等于下单，不会自动成立付费项目，也不要求你继续合作。我们会先了解需求、提供书面方案，并在范围、费用和实际签约双方明确后才开始工作。
项目合作条款说明通常的合作方式，仅在被纳入或接受为书面项目协议的一部分时适用于该项目。具体项目约定与其不一致时，在适用法律允许的范围内，以双方明确的项目约定为准。

sections.title: 5. 外部服务与可用性
body: 部分链接通往由第三方运营的社交平台、邮箱和其他工具，你使用这些服务时适用其条款与隐私规则。我们无法控制其内容或保证持续可用。
我们会合理维护本网站，但仍可能发生维护、中断或错误。如发现功能故障或信息不准确，请联系我们。

sections.title: 6. 法定权利与条款更新
body: 本条款不排除、限制或修改依法不可排除的权利、保证或救济，包括适用的澳洲消费者法权利。
我们可能通过发布带日期的新版本更新网站条款，适用于之后的使用；未经双方同意，更新不会改变已有项目协议，也不会覆盖你的法定权利。有问题或投诉，请联系 emvalue.studio@gmail.com。

project-terms.title: 项目合作条款
project-terms.intro: 把合作的关键事项说在前面。具体交付、职责、费用与约定，以你确认的书面项目方案为准。

sections.title: 1. 确认合作协议
body: 开始付费工作前，书面协议会明确实际服务提供方与客户，以及适用的经营登记信息。emvalue 是我们对外介绍服务所使用的工作室品牌。
这些通用条款仅在纳入或接受为项目协议一部分后适用；方案应说明接受方式与生效时间。仅发送咨询不会使任何一方自动承担项目合作义务。

sections.title: 2. 范围、内容与修改
body: 方案会明确页面、功能、平台、语言、交付物、修改轮次及不包含的事项。你提供约定的业务信息、素材、访问权限与确认，并确保所提供素材具备必要的使用权。
文案、摄影、翻译、业务宣传与法律内容由谁负责，会提前约定。超出既定范围的改动，先说明费用与时间影响，经确认后再开展额外工作。

sections.title: 3. 时间与确认
body: 项目节点根据范围、排期，以及内容、访问权限和反馈的提供时间约定。发生延误或依赖事项变化时，双方及时沟通并协商更新安排。
你会获得预览或其他约定的审阅机会。我们记录反馈，并约定完成与验收的确认方式；本通用条款不会把沉默自动视为验收通过。

sections.title: 4. 报价与付款
body: 书面报价会说明币种、费用、付款节点、报价有效期，以及是否适用 GST。仅在依法适用时收取 GST。任何预付款及其用途，均在付款前说明。
域名、主机、付费软件、应用商店账户与其他必要的第三方订阅，会视需要单独列出。额外费用须先获同意；后续续费及承担方会在你确认前说明。

sections.title: 5. 归属、许可与交接
body: 你原有的内容与素材仍归你所有。协议会明确已付费的定制交付物中授予或转移的权利、提供的文件与权限，以及约定的交接付款条件。
第三方字体、素材、开源代码、平台及已有工具仍受各自许可约束，我们会说明相关限制。条件允许时，域名与服务账户应注册在你名下，再授予我们完成工作所需的权限。

sections.title: 6. 上线、修复与持续支持
body: 项目协议会明确测试、上线职责，以及报告和修复不符合约定规格的问题的流程，同时保留法律要求的权利。
主机管理、内容修改、备份、安全更新与响应安排，仅在明确约定时包含在服务内；额外维护可以另行安排。第三方审批、平台规则与服务中断，可能影响上线或运行。

sections.title: 7. 暂停或结束合作
body: 如一方需要暂停或结束项目，双方会讨论通知、已完成工作、交付物与合理的后续安排。违约及补救机会按协议和适用法律处理。
结算会合理考虑约定的已完成工作，以及已经批准并产生的第三方成本；未使用的预付款与退款据此处理，并遵守适用的消费者权利。本通用条款不会把所有预付款一律规定为不退，也不要求支付全部未完成工作。

sections.title: 8. 保密与项目展示
body: 双方应仅为约定工作或法律要求使用对方的非公开项目信息，并限制为需要知悉的人访问。对有额外要求的项目，可以另行约定保密或数据处理安排。
将你的商家名称、项目截图或评价用于我们的作品集或宣传之前，我们会征求许可，除非你已经明确同意该用途。

sections.title: 9. 解决问题与法定权利
body: 如有疑问，请通过 emvalue.studio@gmail.com 提出，我们会善意沟通并尝试解决。这不妨碍任何一方寻求建议、联系监管机构或使用可用的法律救济。
本条款不排除、限制或修改依法不可排除的权利、消费者保证或救济，包括在适用情况下的澳洲消费者法权利。任何项目专属的责任限制也必须尊重这些权利。
